input.title: Men's Sasquatch – Camera Shy Embroidered Zip Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

This sasquatch zip up hoodie is for the guy who hides his face the second anyone lifts a phone, zipped on for the trailhead and the long walk through the pines.

A shaggy green and rust sasquatch covers its face with one hand and walks between two pine trees and ferns, inside a round patch of forest, in green, rust, brown and cream with a worn print texture. CAMERA SHY sits below it in two huge lines of tall condensed capitals: cream on Black and Navy, forest green on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small CAMERA over SHY wordmark in the same condensed capitals as the back is embroidered on the left chest, and the word BLURRY is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest CAMERA SHY wordmark and left-cuff BLURRY, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the Camera Shy zip hoodie fit?
The Camera Shy sasquatch zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this sasquatch hoodie warm enough for cold trailheads?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles cold trailheads, misty mornings and the walk back to the truck well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, the sasquatch above CAMERA SHY, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small CAMERA over SHY wordmark in the same condensed capitals as the back sits on the left chest, and BLURRY is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The CAMERA SHY wordmark on the chest and the BLURRY cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a hiker, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the friend who hikes for the quiet and ducks every group photo. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
